access_not_recorded.meaning: a returned hit's access event or warm-up failed (hits unaffected)

adapters_busy.meaning: at least one recall adapter was busy

adapters_shadow.meaning: recall adapters run in shadow mode (not in the answer)

adapters_timeout.meaning: at least one recall adapter timed out

all_sources_failed.meaning: every source failed: an empty answer proves nothing

empty_degraded.meaning: nothing came back while a path was degraded or fell back: not proof of absence

expansion_empty.meaning: multihop expansion added no hit; first-hop results only

fts_fallback.meaning: a single-source answer came from the FTS fallback (primary path failed)

grep_fallback.meaning: a single-source answer came from a plain-text grep fallback

keyword_only.meaning: only literal (keyword) matching produced the answer

meta_index_stale.meaning: a metadata index the answer relies on is stale

no_match.meaning: nothing matched, with every path healthy

page_empty.meaning: this page is empty but the search has candidates (offset past them, or cap)

qmd_live_read_errors:<n>.meaning: a QMD live index had <n> read errors

resolver_error:<name>.meaning: the <name> resolver failed; its candidates were dropped

route_fallback.meaning: the routed providers failed; the remaining ones answered

semantic_empty.meaning: the semantic side ran but recalled nothing

semantic_off.meaning: a locality setting kept the query or summaries from the embedder

semantic_partial.meaning: some providers returned partial semantic results

semantic_unavailable.meaning: no embedder is configured: the semantic side did not run

source_busy:<name>.meaning: source <name> was busy (in-flight cap) and was skipped

source_error:<name>.meaning: source <name> failed or returned invalid output

source_fallback:<name>.meaning: in a multi-source answer, source <name> answered from its own fallback

summaries_unavailable.meaning: session summaries/tags could not be read

vectors_partial.meaning: some memories have no vector (kept from an off-host embedder)

withheld_only.meaning: every match was withheld by policy
